criteria.requirement: Implement chardet.batch.detect_many(records, *, on_error="continue", should_rename_legacy=False). Lazily process (id, bytes/bytearray) pairs with fresh real detect calls, preserve index/order/duplicate identifiers and local error facts, and provide continue/stop/raise policies. A failed record has no successful result, stop/close must not consume the tail, upstream generator errors propagate and raw bytes must not be misinterpreted as an iterable batch. Preserve standard detection/fallback facts.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
